criteria_met: The branch has typed variables but a hidden low-support channel could explain the observation.
A controlled contrast can separate visible-channel decay from sector-wide support.
criteria_missing: A transfer certificate to the target observable family is still open.
need_assessment.why_not_direct_derivation_or_probe: A direct derivation would simply assume away the hidden channel; the imagined case identifies what the derivation must rule out.

trigger_criteria: The branch has typed variables but no discriminating situation that can expose the hidden assumption.
A follow-up cycle could derive the exact support condition.

situation.title: Two merge lanes with hidden bottleneck capacity
situation.purpose: Separate apparent linear throughput from saturation under hidden bottleneck capacity.
situation.minimal_world: Two traffic streams merge into one lane with a hidden maximum capacity.
situation.mathematical_carrier: A piecewise flow function q=min(q1+q2, C) with a hidden capacity C.
situation.controlled_contrast: Increase input flow before and after the bottleneck capacity is reached.
situation.why_this_situation_is_informative: It distinguishes local linear response from global saturation when a hidden constraint becomes active.
non_claims: This does not prove the target.
This does not replace a spectral theorem.

interventions.operation: Increase q1 while holding q2 and capacity C fixed.
interventions.predicted_direction: qout first increases linearly and then saturates.
interventions.decision_value: If hidden leakage dominates, the branch needs a density or support lemma.

expected_observations.observable: slope of qout as q1 increases
expected_observations.expected_pattern: Slope transitions from one to zero at the bottleneck.
expected_observations.what_it_would_teach: A hidden capacity constraint can reverse a naive monotonic extrapolation.
expected_observations.what_would_disconfirm_it: A uniform support bound would disconfirm the hidden-tail scenario.

variants.changed_condition: Raise capacity C while holding incoming flows fixed.
variants.predicted_change: The saturation point moves to a larger q1.
variants.reason_for_variant: Tests whether the hidden capacity is the active mechanism.

insight_hypotheses: The branch needs a support or density condition before promoting decay.

transfer_scope.transfers: The generic mechanism that hidden constraints can turn local linearity into saturation.
transfer_scope.does_not_transfer: Any specific claim about traffic policy or physics targets.
transfer_scope.transfer_certificate_needed: A target-specific map from hidden capacity to the relevant constraint.

proposed_graph_updates.rationale: Hidden leakage must be ruled out before decay is promoted.

followup_cycle_tasks.description: Derive the support condition needed to rule out hidden low-energy leakage.
followup_cycle_tasks.success_criterion: The condition names the observable family and support interval.
followup_cycle_tasks.failure_or_demotion_criterion: If only one observable is controlled, demote to evidence task.
